scope: EXERCISED HOST_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; no real models, GPU, network transport, authority, merge or deployment

compiler.protocol: stdin source to stdout ELF; no rebuild or substitution

artifacts.compression: gzip -n; verification artifact only, not product runtime

robustness.exact: All six axis +/-1/12 modes accepted-correct16/16 at96 and192bit, each seed/split. Boundary1/6 and1/4 descriptive; no general guarantee at equality.
robustness.rm: Every seed/split/budget: single-bit128/128 recovered; double-bit448/448 refused. Repeated deterministic enumeration, not independent statistical trials.
robustness.packed: Every seed/split/budget: all64 single-bit and96 double-bit corruptions accepted wrong; no error detection.
robustness.additive_composition: All nine maximum absolute coordinate-composition residual IEEE values are among {0,4372995238176751616,4386506037058863104,4377498837804122112,4382002437431492608}; Wolfram independently decodes their maximum below1e-12.

independent_wire.limitation: Accepted carriers are independently dequantized, noise-applied, decoded and checked against the learned receiver. Producer encode refusals require99/status1, but stale refused carrier bytes cannot independently prove sender-overflow causality.

history: Initial broad Wolfram request failed; narrower exact/RM/derivative calls succeeded and all are retained. Compiler register-pressure and boolean-to-ulong issues were repaired without changing frozen design, seed, split, loss, epoch, rate, threshold or quantization. Initial mutant fixture expected exit labels47/50 were corrected to source-defined46/51 after native guards refused; no guard or gate was weakened. Conductor scratch-existing/context mistakes were setup failures, not experimental results.
verdict: Exact and RM constructions meet synthetic recoverability thresholds. Additive improves new-split held-out recovery versus existing learned but fails16/16 fullfit and8/8 heldout; preregistered learned hypothesis NOT_SUPPORTED. No learned-channel advantage or useful compression demonstrated. Johnson-Lindenstrauss real-activation experiment NOT_RUN, future only.
guides: No Omega language/compiler/pin/host-word/bridge/repository/gate/harness change; experiment-local additions only. omega-harness guide update not applicable.
